* Migrate to Java 25 (LTS) and Scala 3.9.0 (LTS)
* Bundle a Java 25 runtime with jpackage (separate Java installation is no longer required)
* Update libraries (JNA 5.19.1, SWT 3.135.0, Logback 1.6.8, SLF4J 2.0.20, scala-logging 3.9.6)
* Drop the 32-bit (x86) package; only Windows 10 / 11 x64 is supported
* Keep `W10Wheel.exe` together with the `app` and `runtime` folders (the exe cannot be moved alone)
* Existing settings files (`.W10Wheel*.properties` in the user directory) are used as-is

Verify the download with `W10Wheel-2.8.0-x64.zip.sha256`.
